title: Clockfield: inflation, autopsy, and computational residue
summary: A pruning pass through the Clockfield family. It keeps toy dynamics and later computational extractions separate from grand physics identifications, records the GOE/prime-trace and SimpsonsUniverse corrections, and follows the surviving local-time/geometry ideas into HorizonNet, OutoSynapsi, and the Physics Router inside ClockfieldUnified.

nodes.claim: A nonlinear scalar-field toy combines amplitude-dependent propagation with persistent noise and reports a cos² phase-mismatch transmission law alongside frozen-time vortex geometry.
nodes.survived: The repository contains explicit, runnable field and noise experiments and a useful distinction between demonstrated toy behavior and unestablished particle-physics claims.
nodes.killed: It does not establish formal quantization, Bell-inequality physics, stable finite-mass particles, the Standard Model gauge group, or a derivation of α=1/137.

nodes.claim: Extends the same frozen-time field into repulsion-versus-trapping, vortex-collision and shell-leakage experiments, then interprets them as quantum/gravity analogies.
nodes.survived: A concrete nonlinear-field phase-regime playground with explicit escape-suppression and vortex-collision tests; its own ledger already separates toy numerics from missing quantitative physics.
nodes.killed: The experiments do not establish quantitative Hawking radiation, black-hole entropy, non-Abelian gauge structure, stable particle spectra, formal quantization, or information conservation.

nodes.claim: Applies the Γ-shell/freeze picture to a cosmological thaw cascade after first linearizing the metric variable.
nodes.survived: The cleanest mathematical move is the linearization u=1+τβ and the insistence that a later correction separate trivial metric calculus from nontrivial boundary/topology questions.
nodes.killed: The repository's cosmological identifications, CMB-level interpretation and α-related boundary story were not established by the toy mathematics and were later narrowed by the synthesis/audit line.

nodes.claim: Explicitly synthesizes Clockfield physics toys and the Geometric-Neuron/Deerskin program into one delay→resonance→gate→storage operator story.
nodes.survived: It is a useful historical convergence point: delay geometry, phase-sensitive readout, local gating and slow structural storage were being recognized as the same abstract pipeline across projects.
nodes.killed: The document's physical identifications—qubits, entanglement channels, α≈1/137, cosmological predictions and a universal one-solution architecture—remain conjectural and several were later explicitly pruned.

nodes.claim: A relational phase-frustration cosmology later carries its own post-flight audit of the claimed random-matrix/Riemann connection.
nodes.survived: The audit is the important artifact: a reusable prime-trace falsifier and the recognition that level-repulsion statistics establish an ensemble class, not arithmetic identity.
nodes.killed: The original GUE/Riemann reading failed: the real-symmetric operator measured GOE-like r≈0.5306, and the prime-log Fourier test returned a strict null indistinguishable from generic GOE chaos.

nodes.claim: An adelic/prime cosmology was later re-audited by a committed 'Straightening' analysis and reproducible controls.
nodes.survived: A smaller pure-math object survives: iteration on Beurling generalized-number systems, where multiplicative lattices—not the primes specifically—drive strong spectral-repulsion behavior worth further study.
nodes.killed: The prime-specific ontology, the headline GUE constant, α=1/137 construction, cyclotomic SU(3) story, Γ(3/2) temperature claim and shell-thickness decoration fail concrete checks or controls.

nodes.claim: A Banach-style sound halting certificate for weight-tied inference was followed through an autopsy that killed the speedup headline.
nodes.survived: The certificate becomes a rigorous idleness diagnostic, and the deeper lesson is that the useful horizon belongs to observer/decision resolution rather than state-space convergence.
nodes.killed: The reported 65×/15× savings were measurements of absurdly over-iterated baselines; on a well-specified model the certificate fires essentially zero times before useful computation is done.

nodes.claim: Makes 'plasticity changes geometry' exact inside a finite spectral triple, then attacks which geometry actually predicts local dynamics.
nodes.survived: Traffic-driven coupling can approach analytic fixed-budget optima; later gates show the body can support multiple legitimate geometries and can identify an effective geometry from scalar arrival-time consequences.
nodes.killed: Connes distance is not the propagation time of the tested D²-like diffusion; 'learning changes geometry' is incomplete until the signal operator and task-relevant distance are specified.

nodes.claim: Later synthesis explicitly prunes failed/decorative physics claims and extracts a separate Physics Router: one fixed resonant body with adaptable space couplings and local clock/inertia routes spectral content without a per-input branch selector.
nodes.survived: The computational extraction is narrow and reproducible: joint space+local-time structure routes unseen nearby tones and finite packet mixtures, and local traffic eligibility plus one global scalar consequence can train the body.
nodes.killed: The α=1/137 derivation, gauge-group-from-primes story, 5.1ℓP shell thickness, no-free-parameters particle/cosmology claims and other grand identifications are explicitly dead or decorative; the Physics Router makes no gravity claim.

ClockfieldAsUniversalOperator explicitly lists Geometric-Neuron and maps its delay/resonance/gating pipeline onto the Clockfield story.

The earlier Clockfield repo makes adaptive local time the central computational variable; ClockfieldUnified's later Physics Router deliberately extracts adaptive local time as node inertia/clock scale while separating it from gravity claims.

ClockfieldUnified explicitly points to Straightening the Simpsons Universe as the audit that killed α=1/137, prime/gauge decorations and related grand claims carried into the earlier cosmological story.
The later synthesis keeps interface/criticality metaphors but explicitly demotes several load-bearing physical identifications that the universal-operator document treated as empirical foundation.
ClockfieldUnified explicitly names HorizonNet as a companion and compares its independently obtained transient-versus-fixed-point autopsy with the Clockfield interface/freeze picture.
The Physics Router README explicitly says it is a computational offshoot of ClockfieldUnified and OutoSynapsi, combining adaptive coupling geometry with adaptive local clock/inertia.

motifs.title: Grand theory prunes to a smaller machine
motifs.description: Several Clockfield branches over-identify toy structure with fundamental physics; later audits keep the executable mechanism or mathematical object while deleting the cosmological/particle interpretation.

motifs.title: The useful horizon belongs to the observer, not the fixed point
motifs.description: HorizonNet's autopsy finds that useful transient computation precedes state convergence; ClockfieldUnified independently elevates an interface/boundary reading rather than treating the frozen bulk as the active object.

motifs.title: Traffic can write a reusable body geometry
motifs.description: OutoSynapsi derives traffic-dependent structural allocation under explicit budgets; ClockfieldUnified then uses persistent spatial couplings and local inertias as the routing body rather than choosing a branch per input.

motifs.title: Local timescale survives after the physics story is stripped away
motifs.description: Clockfield starts from adaptive local time, OutoSynapsi shows that operator choice changes the structural learning law, and the Physics Router turns local inertia/time scale into a measurable routing resource without importing gravity.
